title: Asset Management System
description: An enterprise Asset Management platform designed and developed to track, manage, and audit organizational physical and digital assets throughout their full lifecycle. Features asset categorization, barcode/tag tracking, maintenance scheduling, depreciation calculation, transfer logs, user assignment, and real-time inventory reporting dashboards.
shortDescription: Full lifecycle asset tracking, maintenance logs & inventory audit dashboards

title: Ticket Support System with Tasks Management
description: A unified Helpdesk Ticket Support and Project Task Management System. Enables multi-tier support ticketing with automated assignment, priority escalation, internal agent collaboration, Kanban task boards, milestone tracking, SLA monitoring, and comprehensive client resolution analytics.
shortDescription: Unified client ticketing, Kanban task boards, SLA tracking & resolution workflows

title: School Record Management System (RMS)
description: A high-integrity School Record Management System engineered for educational institutions to digitize and manage institutional student records, enrollment workflows, grading sheets, academic transcript archives, and faculty access controls. Delivered as a team-collaborated project with 3 developers, each owning designated modules of the system.
shortDescription: Comprehensive student records, enrollment workflows & institutional grading — built with a 3-developer team

title: School Website with Content Management System (CMS)
description: Custom School Portal and Content Management System deployed across educational institutions. Streamlines academic announcements, admissions inquiries, department portals, event publishing, and administrative content authoring with role-based permissions.
shortDescription: Institutional school website with dynamic CMS, portal access & announcements

title: School Attendance Monitoring System (SAMS)
description: A school attendance monitoring platform designed and developed to automate student and faculty attendance tracking. Features real-time reporting, administrative analytical dashboards, automated parent notification logs, and RFID hardware integration.
shortDescription: School attendance tracking with admin dashboards & planned RFID integration

title: Business Management & Inventory System (BMIS)
description: Full-cycle business management and inventory tracking platform engineered to support real-time stock monitoring, purchase orders, sales tracking, and operational management.
shortDescription: End-to-end business management & real-time inventory auditing

title: System Validation Evaluation (SVE) Platform
description: Designed and developed at Classify Inc. to standardize project quality control, evaluation workflows, and turnover training. Features automated evaluation scoring, audit trails, certificate generation upon completion, and comprehensive admin oversight.
shortDescription: Quality control, turnover training & automated certificate generation

title: Department of Agriculture Request & Travel Order System
description: Developed during ICT Internship at Department of Agriculture. Digital internal service request portal and travel order management platform with automated approvals, multi-tier routing, and PDF travel order generation.
shortDescription: Digitized service request tracking & automated travel order approvals
